how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_021.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_greate: Summon your contracted greater elemental spirit to have it purge the world of heretics for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_hound_: Summon a Hound Dog to temporarily fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_medium: Summon your contracted elemental spirit to temporarily fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_otherw: Summon a human from a different world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.suppressor.de: Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.survivor.desc: Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.swipe.descrip: Slashing through space in a straight line, displacing entities or teleporting the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.telepathy.des: Give orders to tames when looking at them through commands.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.teleport.desc: Quickly blink forward in space to a location within view.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thermal_fluct: Ignore weaker thermal damage regardless of its type or resist stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_accel: Increase the speed at which you think to cast magic more quickly as well as to increase your reaction speed.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_commu: Send commands to nearby allies and become able to instruct them to attack players.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thrower.descr: Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder.descr: Strike powerful thunder where the caster looks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_breat: Release thunder from your mouth to damage foes in front of you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_lance: Strike powerful thunder lances of magic.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_orb.d: Call forth a sphere of thunder that strikes any enemy get by.
Call forth a wide area of thunder clouds that strike all enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.titanificatio: Grow into a towering titan to massively increase your strength, defense, and reach while gaining immunity to magic from weaker foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tornado_blade: Fire a concentrated sphere of wind toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.traveler.desc: Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.true_darkness: Inflict Blindness on all entities and deal massive spiritual damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tuner.descrip: Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultra_instinc: Enhance your sense to dodge physical impact.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultrasonic_wa: Shoot out a screech of sound which damages physical bodies or use echolocation to highlight nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultraspeed_re: Boost your bodies healing to nearly impossible levels
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.universal_per: Combine all magic, sound and heat sense to detect entities around.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unpredictabil: In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unyielding.de: Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.
